page.layout: One printed page (left page of an opening, the right page is only edge). Running head at top: "De Lib noui Test." left and "Lib.9." right. Page number 386 above the head. Main text column in the centre with a brace-set synopsis; a narrow column of marginal notes at the left margin ("De libr. noui Test. cap.11." and "Cor.3.4.cap."). Catchword "Quod" at lower right.

main_text.l: Illud autē {a}Prædicatione fua. 2.Thes.2.15,
faciebant Scriptis suis. Ioa.17.20.
Prædicatio erat ex scripturis propheticis.Rom.
Scripta autem vel propria ipsorum manu,
vel ab ipsorum ore, vel ex ipsorum voluntate spiri-
tus etiam motu perfectissime exarata & Apostolorū
testimonio ornata sunt.Luc.1.2.3.4.5. Rom.16.22. 1.
Cor.16.21. Coloss.4.18. 2.Thes.3.17. Quare tunc
verbum in Euangelica politeia sunt libri noui testa-
menti.
Libri noui fœderis sunt qui præcipuè
nouum fœdus explicant.Luc.1.2.3. Heb 3.4.5.6.7.8. cap. 2.
Vnde omnium librorum volumen nouum te-
stamentum dicitur.
Ex ἐξηγήσεως Historici Christo. sunt
de Actis Apost. Propheticus vnicus, ἀποκαλύψις Io-
annis.
De Christo historici sunt quatuor à duobus A-
postolis Matheo & Ioanne, duobus Euangelistis Mar-
co & Luca conscripti, quorum singuli continent hi-
storiam sufficientem, omnes verò quam perfecti-
ssimam de Christi secundum humanitatem origine,
vita, morte, ipsiusq; factis & dictis omnibus, quantū
euangelicæ doctrinæ interest.Luc.1.2.3.4.5.Act.1.1.2. Ioa.21.31.Mar.1.1.& ex inscriptionibus.

page.notes: Synopsis braces and Greek words are only partly legible in the scan (Ex ἐξηγήσεως line and the Greek of the Apocalypse); the Greek is transcribed as best read. The reference mark {a} is inferred from the sense. Right page is only an edge and is not transcribed.
